# Imikan Technologies

> Imikan Technologies is a self-hosted RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and AI chatbot vendor for regulated industries — banking, legal, healthcare, and government — serving Nigeria, Africa, and worldwide. We build enterprise AI systems with data residency, source citations, and sub-second latency.

## About

Imikan Technologies helps organizations turn their unstructured documents into intelligent, verifiable AI. Our systems keep data on infrastructure the client controls, cite their sources, and are built for the accuracy standards that regulated sectors require.

- Company: Imikan Technologies
- Website: https://www.imikan-technologies.com/
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria (serving Nigeria, Africa, and global markets)
- Contact: contact@imikan-technologies.com
- Phone: +234 809 378 1000

## Services

- RAG Systems: Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation on self-hosted pgvector with OpenAI embeddings, vector + keyword hybrid search, intelligent re-ranking, and source-citation tracking.
- AI Chatbots: Grounded, verifiable conversational AI for banking, legal, healthcare, and government use cases.
- Shopify AI Integration: AI shopping assistants with product search, dynamic pricing, inventory sync, automated order handling, and SEO product descriptions.
